title: Pilot customer check-in
transcript:
[00:00] Priya: Quick one. Where are we on single sign-on for the pilot customer?
[00:06] Marco: Login works on staging. I still need to wire up the admin roles.
[00:14] Dana: The customer asked again yesterday. They want to try it this week.
[00:20] Priya: OK, so SSO is ready by Friday. Marco, that's yours?
[00:25] Marco: Yep, I'll have it ready by Friday.
[00:29] Dana: Great, I'll tell them Friday.
[00:33] Dana: They also asked about adding their users automatically from their directory.
[00:40] Priya: Let's cover user provisioning in the pilot.
[00:44] Marco: Fine by me.
[00:47] Dana: Good, I'll put it in the pilot plan.

readings.reading: Merged and deployed to staging by Friday; production the following week.
Directory sync is built during the pilot and switched on a few weeks in; until then users are added by hand.
Code complete on staging by Friday end of day, including admin roles.
The pilot customer uploads a CSV of users; directory sync is a later project after the pilot.
The customer's admins can log in to production on Friday morning.
Directory sync works from the customer's first pilot day, together with SSO.
